title: Microplate Reader Workflow
author: NUS iGEM
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8bqhsmw

steps.title: Refresh Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Refresh the overnight cell culture in LB media at 37 °C.

steps.title: Measure Optical Density
steps.instruction: Measure the OD 600 of the cell culture to reach the desired OD value.

steps.title: Prepare 96-well Plate
steps.instruction: Load cell samples and chemical inducers into a 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Load 200 µL of cell samples into three wells (triplicates).
Induce each well with appropriate volumes of chemical inducers, ensuring the volume does not exceed 6 µL.

steps.title: Load Microplate Reader
steps.instruction: Load the plate (with lid) into the Cytation 5 microplate reader.

steps.title: Run Continuous Measurement Protocol
steps.instruction: Start the protocol for continuous overnight measurement using the following parameters based on the required script:

substeps.instruction: OD 600 (absorbance): Wavelength 600nm, measurement interval 8min, run time 18h.
OD 600 + GFP script: Measurement interval 8min, run time 18h.
OD 600 + luminescence script: Measurement interval 20min, run time 20h.
